summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded software and firmware experience in C/C++ across STM32 microcontrollers, Arduino, and NVIDIA Jetson Embedded Linux. Built bare-metal and FreeRTOS firmware with board-level peripheral control over UART/I2C/SPI, and deployed edge inference services on Jetson under real-time and memory constraints.

Linux Administration: systemd service management (unit files, auto-restart, non-root isolation)

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed embedded sensing firmware for a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Built Cortex-M4 embedded firmware with timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system across a Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a WebSocket fabric; TensorRT-optimized YOLO gave a 5.2× speedup (56.7→10.9 ms, 92 FPS).

Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency after resolving 11 integration failures (servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); implemented two-link IK in Arduino C++ with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over a TCA9548A I2C mux.
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation, environment-file config) on Embedded Linux with static IP networking.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.

Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands; used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline with an 80-channel mel spectrogram DSP front-end and a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend (4–5.5× speedup); achieved 15% WER on Indian-English NPTEL data.
